headline: SpaceX Super Intelligence has bundled X Premium, Grok and Cursor into one plan called The X Subscription, with five tiers from free to $200 a month.
score_reason: Pool score kept: a pricing and packaging change from a large AI and social media company, useful to subscribers but not a technical advance.
importance_line: Subscribers to X, Grok or Cursor can get chat, coding and X's paid features under one plan, and it shows AI firms competing on bundles against OpenAI and Anthropic, but the upgrade rolls out gradually and no subscriber numbers are given.
summary: TechCrunch reports that the company it calls SpaceX Super Intelligence is bundling its X Premium, Grok and Cursor subscriptions into one plan, The X Subscription, with a free tier and paid tiers of $8, $30, $100 and $200 a month. Premium or higher is needed for the latest Grok models, usage caps rise with each tier, and the company says the comparable plan costs existing X Premium+ subscribers the same or less.
notes: Read in full on TechCrunch. Grok is the company's AI chatbot and Cursor an AI coding tool, as the article describes them.
